context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression file: /app/backend/tests/test_iter209_tone_memory_autowa.py. Run from /app/backend: `PYTHONPATH=/app/backend REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<preview> python -m pytest tests/test_iter209_tone_memory_autowa.py -o 'addopts=' -v`. The test monkey-patches routes.mira_outreach._raw_db to an AsyncIOMotorClient bound to the shared _LOOP (motor's default client is bound to FastAPI's uvicorn loop and raises 'future belongs to different loop' when driven from pytest). Pymongo is used for DB inspection/cleanup to sidestep the same issue. All assertions on phone_only=10 depend on the current preview seed (10 phone-only leads under PHONE_ONLY_QUERY); if seed changes, the UI chip label will change but the shape test still holds.
